prompts.premium:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a PREMIUM GAME UI ICON ATLAS for Grid Rush, a Persian tilework board game. Reference image is ONLY a benchmark for the lavish, individually painted fantasy game inventory icon quality: richly sculpted gold edges, enamel inlays, dimensional gemstones, razor sharp silhouette, hand-painted 2.5D material rendering. Do not copy Egyptian motifs. Deliver 16 different icons in a precisely aligned 4 by 4 atlas, transparent background, generous empty gutter around each icon. No text, labels, tiles behind icons, grids, captions or watermark. Square canvas at highest available quality. Each icon is a complete standalone isolated asset occupying its own equal square cell with no overlapping effects.
ART DIRECTION: authentic Persian Isfahan haft-rangi glazed ceramic, fine cobalt and turquoise enamel, engraved gold arabesque filigree, tiny khatai blossoms, girih knot engraving, eight-point shamseh stars, precise metal bevels, micro crackle glaze, luminous turquoise cabochon gems. Deep navy #001E67, lapis #00308D, azure #17A8F0, turquoise #0AB6CB, emerald #27B67A, saffron #FFB400, gold #E3A71A, terracotta #E5553F, ivory #FFF6DE. Gold frames around ceramic cores. Vibrant, exquisite premium mobile game collectible illustration with top-left warm light, controlled highlights, readable strong shapes. Comparable visual richness to the reference screenshot's Egyptian inventory icons but entirely Iranian decorative craft. Not flat SVG, not minimalist line art, not emoji. No Egyptian ankhs, scarabs, pyramids, hieroglyphs, religious text.
Each row left-to-right exactly:
ROW 1: ornate Persian treasure chest open with turquoise ceramic panels and gold coins; exquisite polished turquoise currency gemstone in golden arabesque mount; stack of engraved Persian gold coins; turquoise ceramic hourglass with gold filigree and saffron sand.
ROW 2: eight-point shamseh achievement star medallion; Persian jeweled crown with floral goldwork; heavy ornate gilded lock with lapis ceramic face; glazed turquoise gift box with sculpted gold ribbon.
ROW 3: miniature Persian pointed-arch museum gateway with tiled muqarnas; ornate golden trophy with turquoise floral enamel bowl; elegant Persian scroll with golden end caps and small blue tile seal; ornate daily calendar plaque in ceramic and gold with a geometric sun motif and no numbers.
ROW 4: azure star-shaped glazed player pawn on gold base; coral star-shaped glazed player pawn on gold base; elaborate navy ceramic settings cog with gold teeth and turquoise gemstone hub; heart-shaped ruby red ceramic like/vote medallion enclosed in Persian gold floral filigree.
Consistent front three-quarter view, centered composition, equal visual scale, each object approximately 75 percent of cell width. Crisp edges with true transparent alpha, no dark background painted in.
prompts.frames:
Use case: stylized-concept. A production art atlas for Grid Rush Persian tilework premium board game, 12 separate UI ornament objects in an exact 3 columns by 4 rows grid, transparent background, high resolution, no text or letters. Equal square cells, each object fits within 80% of its cell with wide transparent spacing. Luxurious hand-painted fantasy mobile game art, chunky carved gold frames, turquoise cabochon gemstones, lustrous deep blue glazed ceramic, tiny floral enamel filigree, precise bevel highlights, convincing crafted dimensional volume. Extremely polished and intricately detailed, NOT flat vector graphics. Palette lapis navy #001E67, turquoise #0AB6CB, gold #E3A71A, ivory #FFF6DE, saffron #FFB400, terracotta #E5553F. Persian Isfahan kashi-kari and khatai/eslimi ornament, no Egyptian designs or religious symbols. Warm upper-left light. Empty interior surfaces are calm to permit overlaying game UI text.
Row 1 left to right: large turquoise primary button, wide rounded rectangle gold edge and layered ceramic pressed lip with small centered shamseh cap and navy underside; ivory secondary button with thin engraved gold border and turquoise corner stones; terracotta danger button with same matching carved gold frame.
Row 2: empty cream modal dialog frame, gold Persian floral corner filigree and lapis header, generous blank center; empty pointed-arch hero frame, elaborate muqarnas golden top and turquoise tile pillars, navy empty opening; ornate portrait offer card frame with pointed arch opening, gold bevel and tiny turquoise diamond above, ivory blank price plaque below.
Row 3: victory banner made of saffron enamel and curling gold ribbon with shamseh crest, empty center; lapis heading ribbon with gilded curled ends and tiny central turquoise gem, empty center; defeat banner of muted red ceramic with carved gold edges and modest decorative crest, empty center.
Row 4: circular avatar medallion empty navy opening in thick engraved gold rim with turquoise and ivory khatai florets and a small empty star level badge; ornate horizontal experience progress tube with a translucent turquoise glazed fill, gold end caps and star finial, no text; ornate 9 by 9 board outer frame with gilded eight-point star corner caps, turquoise inner rim and completely empty dark navy square center.
Objects are isolated true transparent PNG artwork with no scenery, no drop shadow outside each cell, no watermark. Emphasize physical richness of gold carving and ceramic glaze while maintaining clear silhouettes.
prompts.framesCorrection: Edit the supplied UI asset sheet. Preserve the exact beautiful Persian ceramic-and-gold material rendering and all TWELVE objects. CRITICAL corrections: completely remove the brown/gold scenery backdrop and all background shading, producing TRUE TRANSPARENT ALPHA between objects. Recompose into an EXACT evenly spaced 3 columns by 4 rows atlas. Each cell must be exactly the same square size; square objects fit within a cell and wide objects are proportionally scaled down to fit their cell. Do not stretch them. Do not allow any object crossing a cell edge. Leave 10% transparent padding inside every cell. Output a portrait canvas with aspect ratio 3:4. Row1 turquoise primary button / ivory button / terracotta button. Row2 cream modal panel / pointed arch empty hero frame / portrait offer card frame. Row3 gold victory ribbon / lapis ribbon / red defeat ribbon. Row4 circular empty avatar frame / turquoise progress tube / square board frame. Absolutely NO opaque background, gradient backdrop, text, labels, checkerboard painted into image. Retain the original objects with their intricate carved gold, floral tile ornament and clean blank interiors.
prompts.tiles:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production-quality game tile art atlas, exact FOUR COLUMNS by SIX ROWS, 24 individual square glazed Persian ceramic tiles. Transparent background in the gutters, every tile perfectly top-down with square silhouette, centered in its identical cell with 8% clear gutter. Absolutely exquisite and richly detailed authentic Isfahan haft-rangi tilework, sophisticated hand-painted Persian khatai flowers and eslimi arabesques, intricate traditional girih geometry, fine golden contour work and crisp dark lapis outlines. Premium fantasy game painted assets with lustrous glaze, subtle crazing, subtle bevels and gilded edge. Strong visible material quality, precise sharp motifs, dense but organized details. Every tile is a finished beautiful work of ceramic art, not a simple icon on a plain square. Fine multi-layer floral ornament in corners and central medallions. Palette constrained to deep cobalt #00308D, navy #001E67, turquoise #0AB6CB, azure #17A8F0, emerald #27B67A, saffron #FFB400, gold #E3A71A, terracotta #E5553F, ivory #FFF6DE. Warm top-left studio illumination and no perspective distortion. No lettering, no religious calligraphy, no Egyptian motifs, no frames or text labels around the atlas.
Each pair of consecutive tiles is the SAME motif with two rich contrasting grounds: first lapis ground, then ivory ground. Read left to right:
Row1: eight-point star medallion lapis; eight-point star medallion ivory; interwoven girih knot lapis; interwoven girih knot ivory.
Row2: khatai blossom lapis; khatai blossom ivory; curling eslimi scroll lapis; curling eslimi scroll ivory.
Row3: Persian cypress lapis; Persian cypress ivory; pomegranate floral motif lapis; pomegranate floral motif ivory.
Row4: shamseh sunburst lapis; shamseh sunburst ivory; interlaced hexagon network lapis; interlaced hexagon network ivory.
Row5: fine diagonal geometric lattice lapis; lattice ivory; concentric floral medallion lapis; medallion ivory.
Row6: Persian songbird in flowering vine lapis; bird and vine ivory; chevron with floral ornament lapis; chevron ivory.
24 equally sized completely separate tile faces. Professional stylized game illustration rather than flat vector. The finest level of ornament and finish, harmonious repeatable design language.
prompts.avatars:
Use case: stylized-concept. A breathtaking premium game avatar medallion collection for a Persian tilework board game. Exact 4 columns by 6 rows, 24 DISTINCT circular gold-rimmed collectible medallions, isolated transparent background, no text or lettering, highest resolution. All medallions equal size and aligned in equal square cells, generous gutters. This must be extraordinarily detailed polished fantasy inventory art like expensive jeweled collectibles, not flat geometric SVG placeholders. Each one features deep carved gold arabesque filigree, turquoise cabochons, raised ceramic floral ornament, fine enamel lines, 2.5D bevels and warm top-left lighting. Consistent thick gold rim with tiny lapis/ivory inlaid khatai florets and small blank eight-point-star level badge at the bottom. Each medallion has a DIFFERENT distinctive central Persian tile-art emblem, never a human face. Jewel colors cobalt, turquoise, emerald, ivory, saffron and terracotta. Persian Isfahan arts, no Egyptian emblems, no religious symbols, no letters.
Left to right:
Row1: turquoise eight-point shamseh sun on lapis; ivory khatai blossom on emerald; ruby pomegranate with gold leaves; elegant tall cypress on ivory.
Row2: turquoise songbird amongst gold flowering vines; ivory nightingale perched on terracotta floral branch; gold interwoven girih knot on navy; azure rosette with gold stamens.
Row3: emerald arabesque spiral with ivory petals; gold interlaced hexagons on turquoise; terracotta tulip with sapphire leaves; layered saffron sunflower with lapis center.
Row4: rich turquoise peacock feather medallion; ivory blooming lotus rendered in Persian tile painting; golden eight-point star with emerald center; sapphire and ivory checker lattice rosette.
Row5: gold vase of khatai flowers; turquoise Persian dome silhouette with floral tile ornament; pair of gold leaves around a red bud; interlocked ivory and blue eight-point stars.
Row6: golden Persian lion decorative motif on lapis; turquoise butterfly amongst ivory flowers; emerald garden tree and gold birds; intricate ivory mandala with sapphire and ruby floral details.
The final image must feel like 24 costly physical ceramic and gold jewelry pieces with elegant rich material shading, sharp edges and strong silhouettes, ready for a polished mobile game. No scenery or backing cards behind the circular medallions.
